questions.question: Janet says that over time, shampoo has become

analyses.content: 录音中提到洗发水从以前经济实惠的清洁用品演变成了现在的美容产品，说明它的商品性质发生了根本变化。
你可能会因为听到“economical”就错选A（变便宜），但录音说的是“以前”是经济的清洁方式，而不是指现在的洗发水变得更便宜了。

I've read how shampoo marketing has developed over the last hundred years. Oh, I didn't think we needed to do that. True, but I'm interested anyway. Basically, what was once sold as an economical way of getting your hair clean has evolved into a beauty product.

options.option: Women worry about them more than men.
options.optionContent: Women worry about them more than men.

questions.question: What does Janet say about ‘bad hair days’?

analyses.content: 录音中明确指出耶鲁大学的研究表明“bad hair days”不仅仅是人们的想象（They're not just imagined），也就是说它们是真实存在的。
录音中说男女受到的影响是一样的（equally affected），所以不要因为主观臆断或者没听完整去选B（女人比男人更担心）。

You've heard of bad hair days. ... (中间为男生反驳) ... Well, whatever you want to call them, that's not what research from Yale is suggesting. They're not just imagined, and both sexes are equally affected by them.

questions.question: What do Janet and Michael say about the chemicals used in shampoos?

analyses.content: 录音中提到很多制造商倾向于使用这些化学物质，但他们对此“保持沉默”（keep it quiet），这直接对应了选项中的“极少公开”。
不要因为听到“manufacturers tend to use these or others like them”就选A，录音说的是使用“这些或其他类似的”化学物质，并没有说“所有”洗发水成分都一模一样。
And I've been reading about shampoo ingredients, chemicals like sodium lauryl sulfate. Methyl chloride. Many of the manufacturers tend to use these or others like them, though they keep it quiet.

questions.question: According to Janet, printing directly onto shampoo bottles, rather than onto labels,

analyses.content: 录音提到直接印在瓶子上不能提升视觉效果，而且让人感觉有点廉价（cheap），也就是“不那么吸引人”。
录音里确实提到了花费和时间，但说的是“少花50%的钱”和“过程快得多”，如果你没听清前后的对比关系，极容易错选A（花费更多）或C（花费更长时间）。

Another area it would be interesting to investigate is the labeling on bottles. Apparently, printing directly onto the bottles costs about fifty percent less than sticking a printed label on because it's a much quicker process. Mm. But manufacturers are lukewarm about this because it doesn't enhance the visual impact of the bottle. It comes across as a bit cheap.

questions.question: With regard to environmental issues, Michael and Janet want to investigate

analyses.content: 男生提议调查厂家是否通过“减轻瓶子重量（making it less heavy）”来做到环保，女生表示赞同，这完全对应选项中“瓶子重量的变化”。
录音前半部分确实讨论了“回收塑料”和“外观颜色”，但那是作为背景信息引入的，他们最终决定要“investigate（去研究）”的动作落在了“重量”上，听题时千万别被前面的长篇大论带偏选了A或C。

We need to think about environmental issues. I was surprised how little recycled plastic goes into the bottles. I think it's because light-colored plastic is more difficult to make from recycled stuff. Yeah, but manufacturers can make their packaging more environmentally friendly just by making it less heavy. I'd like to find out whether some of them actually do when we do the research. Yes, that's worth looking into.

options.option: desire to get value for money.
options.optionContent: desire to get value for money.

questions.question: Michael bases his own shampoo purchase decisions on his

analyses.content: 男生说如果看到没见过的牌子，他通常很愿意尝试一下（giving it a go），这说明他买洗发水时“愿意尝试新产品”。
男生明确说到“而不是一辈子只买一两个最爱的品牌（rather than sticking to...）”，所以可以直接排除A（品牌忠诚度）；同时他对特价商品保持警惕，排除B。

Uh, thinking about you as a customer, what's important when choosing shampoo? Hmm, I'm always wary of special offers. When something's flagged as being half price, it rarely is really. But if there's a make I've never seen before, I'm usually up for giving it a go rather than sticking to one or two favorite brands all my life.

groups.contentHtml:
Shampoo advertisements
27. Zing
28. Splash
29. Just go
30. Brozene

analyses.content: 广告里展示了幸福的家庭和漂亮的孩子，让人产生“要是我的生活也那样就好了”的羡慕之情，对应“令人羡慕的生活方式”。
这道题的关键是听到女生的总结句“if only my life was like that”，如果在听的时候只零散听到“家人、孩子”，很容易不知道在表达什么核心概念导致跟丢。

What about Zing? Well, it'd probably appeal equally to men and women. In the ad, we see this happy family, lovely home, healthy, good-looking children. With clean hair. Obviously, yes. And I think we're supposed to watch the ad and think, "Wow, if only my life was like that."
这支广告一直在讲述一对情侣（couple）的故事，悬念是他们会分手还是继续在一起，这显然是以“浪漫爱情”为卖点。
听到“couple”和“break up or stay together”就应该立刻联想到男女关系，不要被前面说的“five minutes”或者“story”干扰而找不到对应选项。

You know that ad for Splash Shampoo that lasts about five minutes and where there's a story? Oh yes. The commercial about the couple? Mm. And all through the commercial, it's not clear if they're going to break up or stay together.
广告包含了很多技术信息让顾客感到放心，并且相信这个产品“能达到他们想要的效果（do the job）”，这就说明产品是“可靠的”。
听到“technical information”很容易去选项里找科学、技术相关的干扰词，但最终落脚点是男生的总结“能起到作用（do the job）”，这里同义替换成了“reliability（可靠性）”。

And then there's the Just Go advertisement. Yes. That had lots of technical information about what the shampoo actually consists of. I suppose they want customers to feel confident that when they buy Just Go, they are at least making an informed decision. Yes. They're buying something that will do the job they want it to. That's it.
录音中提到这支广告伴随着轻柔的音乐和宁静的画面，让人感觉“非常平静（very calming）”，对应选项中的“与放松相关”。
即使你没听懂前面的“no commentary（没有旁白）”，只要抓住了最后的“calming”、“soft”和“peaceful”这几个表达核心情绪的词，就能稳稳选对A。

I've read one of the most effective shampoo ads in recent times was the one for Brozine. Yes, but there's no commentary, just images of the shampoo and lots of clean hair. [laughs] I suppose the effect, though, is very calming with soft music and very peaceful imagery.
